title: A disposable appliance at a high price. Tricky to install.
text:
A disposable appliance at a high price. Tricky to install.. The trim kit fit too tightly and needed to be trimmed to function without door hitting. First one died in a month but was replaced free under warranty with no labor charges.

UPDATE: The second one has also died of the same magnetron failure in less than 2 years (but conveniently out of warranty). GE can't find the record in their system that THEY shipped this one to me. I am not wanting to ever buy another GE appliance as their service is horrible - same for GE Profile refrigerator service, but I don't want to have to buy and install another trim kit. AGH!
